# Ordinary-MAP FRUIT scientific-definition freeze r0.4

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson. Date: 2026-09-09.
Decision identity: `SCI-FRUIT-OD-ORDINARY-MAP-DEFINITION-FREEZE-2026-09-09`.
Disposition: **Q01 scientific definition accepted and frozen after the three
bounded clarifications. Q02 exact upstream amendments remain open and unadopted.**

## Owner authority and scope

The owner supplied the targeted r0.3 review and instructed:

> Here is some feedback.  Let's address these and then lock this down.

This records the instruction as authorization to complete the review's three
clarifications and lock the resulting scientific definition. The review's
recommendation alone is not an owner decision. The accompanying instruction
supplies the lock-down authority, bounded by the supplied review's explicit
Q01/Q02 separation. No fresh vote on the scientific direction is required.

The corrections are: POINT/E01 is a recommendation, not a selected experimental
order; fixed D_a/contributor/PTC support and association are restrictions of
the controlled reference, while general support changes must be explicit and
attributable and cannot masquerade as rejection or convergence; and binary
admission multiplied by reconstructed-total flux is the leading reference
estimator, not a universal requirement for future FRUIT inference/flux models.
No broad scientific rewrite, new algorithm or numerical selection is included.

## What is locked and what is still unavailable

The canonical scientific-definition text is METHOD_DEFINITION.md, paper
revision r0.4. It retains specialization identity
`FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD/ordinary-map-mode-aware-relearning@r0.3`: the paper revision
clarifies its scope without changing its reference algorithm. Acceptance
covers the scientific structure and explicitly conditional reference definition,
including its limitations and typed missing bindings. It does not instantiate
a complete executable numerical method. Engineering requirements are a derived
prospective view, not a second scientific authority or executed evidence.

Q01's scientific-definition review is resolved. Its unbound numerical policy
slots (evidence, hypotheses/priors, statistic/rule/ties, sign and construction)
still require exact choices before numerical application. They remain under
the existing Q01 identity rather than being hidden as approved defaults.

Q02 is not approved by this freeze. The B01–B12 annex is carried byte-for-byte
from r0.3 as proposed/not adopted, including residual-parent permission,
retention applicability, rejoined MAP route/profile, correction embedding,
uniform-occurrence gridding family, QC and retained-use records, and mode
registration. References to those clauses in the scientific definition are
conditional dependencies, not incorporation as adopted upstream authority.
Grouping/effective settings and support-policy values retain their Q03/Q04
bindings. No frozen PTC, CAL, MAP or generic FRUIT source is modified.

E00–E02 remain experiment proposals. POINT is recommended but not selected;
OOF is neither a mandatory successor nor barred from being chosen first.
Exact reference identity remains prerequisite for interpreting any comparison.
Q05/Q06 retain evidence, input, numerical settings, experimental ordering,
case selection, acceptance criteria and separate execution authority.

`FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD = unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval`.
The numerical route remains `unavailable_under_current_frozen_parent_permissions`.
No author dispatch, amendment adoption, implementation, experiment/replay,
injection, Unity action, numerical qualification, policy recommendation or
production behavior is authorized. Historical controls and all existing
products remain preserved. The generic Stage B freeze and its program-order
and conditional-composition authorities are unchanged.
